title: How to Set Up Blink Cloud in Cursor: Add Full-Stack Infrastructure in 2 Minutes
summary: Add database, auth, and hosting to Cursor in one command. Install the Blink plugin with npx skills add, log in, and ask your agent to build and deploy full-stack apps instantly.
body_markdown: MCP tools are functions your agent calls directly —` create_database` ,` deploy_backend` ,` configure_auth` . Skills are instruction sets that teach your agent when and how to use those tools in context. Without skills, your agent knows a function exists. With skills, it knows to infer your database schema from your app code, set the right row-level security per table, and update your environment variables automatically.
